programs.title_tr: Pratt & Whitney GTF (PW1100G) Toz Metal Kusuru & Yere İndirmeler
programs.title_en: Pratt & Whitney GTF (PW1100G) Powder Metal Defect & Groundings
programs.current_status_tr: Yüksek basınçlı türbin disklerindeki mikroskobik toz metal kirliliği nedeniyle küresel çapta yüzlerce A320neo/A321neo uçağı planlanmamış motor bakımına alındı. Ortalama motor revizyon süresi (TAT) 250-300 günü buluyor.
programs.current_status_en: Contaminated powder metal in high-pressure turbine disks required accelerated inspections; hundreds of A320neo family jets grounded globally with MRO shop turnaround times reaching 250-300 days.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: THY filosundaki yaklaşık 30-40 adet A320/A321neo uçağı yerde bekliyor; kapasite açığını kapatmak için ıslak kiralama (wet lease) ve mevcut A320ceo uçaklarının hizmet ömrünü uzatma yoluna gidildi. Pegasus filosu ağırlıklı CFM LEAP motorlu olduğu için doğrudan etkilenmedi.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Turkish Airlines has 30-40 A321neo aircraft parked; capacity shortfall managed via wet leases and extending older A320ceo service lives. Pegasus remains largely unaffected due to CFM LEAP engine selection.
programs.timeline_horizon: 2026 yılı boyunca ve 2027 ilk yarısına kadar sürmesi bekleniyor.
programs.source_reference: RTX Corporation / FAA Airworthiness Directives (AD 2024-0044) / THY KAP Açıklamaları

programs.title_tr: Boeing 737 MAX Üretim Kısıtı (FAA Aylık 38 Tavanı) & Tedarik Zinciri
programs.title_en: Boeing 737 MAX FAA Monthly 38 Cap & Supply Chain Bottlecks
programs.current_status_tr: FAA'in kalite ve montaj denetimleri kapsamında Boeing 737 üretimini aylık 38 uçak tavanında tutması ve Spirit AeroSystems gövde teslimat gecikmeleri nedeniyle 2026 teslimat takvimleri 3-6 ay geriye ötelendi. MAX 7 ve MAX 10 sertifikasyonu gecikmeye devam ediyor.
programs.current_status_en: FAA capped 737 production at 38/month pending quality audit milestones; Spirit AeroSystems fuselage supply constraints pushed airline delivery slots back by 3 to 6 months. MAX 7 and MAX 10 certification remains pending.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: SunExpress ve THY teslimatları planlanan takvimin gerisinde seyrediyor; havayolları yoğun yaz ve sonbahar kapasite planlamalarını mevcut gövdelerle optimize ediyor.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: SunExpress and Turkish Airlines delivery streams experiencing slot postponements; carriers optimizing utilization on existing fleet assets.
programs.timeline_horizon: Aylık 38 üretim tavanının 2026 sonuna kadar aşamalı olarak artırılması hedefleniyor.
programs.source_reference: FAA Oversight Directives / Boeing Quarterly Deliveries / Airline Fleet Filings

programs.title_tr: Airbus A321XLR Ticari Teslimatları & Dar Gövde Uzun Menzil Devrimi
programs.title_en: Airbus A321XLR Entry into Service & Long-Range Narrowbody Wave
programs.current_status_tr: EASA tip sertifikasyonunu tamamlayan A321XLR, Iberia tarafından Madrid-Boston hattında ilk ticari uçuşlarına başladı. 4.700 deniz mili (8.700 km) menziliyle dar gövdede transatlantik ve kıtalararası uçuş maliyetlerini %30 düşürüyor.
programs.current_status_en: Having achieved EASA certification, the A321XLR commenced transatlantic operations with launch customer Iberia. Its 4,700 nm range unlocks thin long-haul routes at 30% lower trip cost.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: Orta Doğu, Afrika ve ikincil Avrupa şehirlerine doğrudan bağlantı potansiyeli nedeniyle bölge taşıyıcıları tarafından yakından izleniyor. THY ve Pegasus filo stratejilerinde uzun vadeli alternatif.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Closely monitored by regional carriers for secondary point-to-point routes into Africa, Central Asia and Europe; potential long-term fit for Istanbul network.
programs.source_reference: EASA Type Certificate Data Sheet (TCDS) / Airbus Commercial Aircraft Updates

programs.title_tr: Boeing 777-9 (777X) Test Uçuşları & Hizmete Giriş Tarihi
programs.current_status_tr: İtiş kolu bağlantı elemanındaki (thrust link) teknik arıza sonrası test uçuşları geçici olarak durdurulmuştu; Boeing ilk teslimat takvimini 2026 yılına (ve potansiyel olarak 2027'ye) revize etti. Başta Emirates ve Lufthansa olmak üzere amiral gemisi filoları A380 ve 777-300ER ömür uzatmak zorunda kaldı.
programs.current_status_en: Structural component inspection on engine thrust links required test fleet pause; initial deliveries rescheduled to 2026/2027. Major customers Emirates and Lufthansa forced to extend legacy 777-300ER and A380 service lives.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: THY'nin geniş gövde siparişlerinde Airbus A350-1000'e ağırlık vermesinde 777X gecikmeleri belirleyici stratejik etken oldu.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Delays were a primary catalyst for Turkish Airlines' decision to anchor its high-capacity widebody order book on the Airbus A350-1000.
programs.timeline_horizon: FAA tip sertifikasyonu ve ilk ticari teslimat 2026 sonu / 2027 hedefleniyor.
programs.source_reference: Boeing Defense, Space & Security / Airline IR Filings / Emirates President Statements

programs.title_tr: CFM LEAP-1A / 1B Yüksek Basınç Türbini Dayanıklılığı & MRO Bekleme Süreleri
programs.title_en: CFM LEAP-1A / 1B Hot-Section Durability & Shop Visit Backlogs
programs.current_status_tr: Sıcak iklim, tozlu hava sahası ve yüksek iniş-kalkış döngüsü altında çalışan LEAP motorlarında türbin kanatçığı erozyonu nedeniyle planlanandan erken motor indirme yaşanıyor. Küresel MRO atölyelerinde yedek parça ve motor kıtlığı devam ediyor.
programs.current_status_en: Harsh environment operations (heat, sand, high cycle utilization) causing premature hot-section turbine blade wear; global MRO shops experiencing parts constraints and extended turn-around times.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: Pegasus'un filosunun belkemiğini oluşturan A321neo uçaklarında CFM LEAP-1A motorları kullanılıyor. Pegasus, proaktif motor rotasyonu ve yedek motor rezervasyonu ile uçak yerde kalma süresini (AOG) asgaride tutuyor.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Pegasus relies heavily on CFM LEAP-1A on its A321neo fleet; carrier leverages proactive engine rotation and buffer lease pools to keep AOG rates minimal.
programs.timeline_horizon: CFM'in güncellenmiş dayanıklı parça (durability kit) teslimatları 2026 boyunca yaygınlaşıyor.
programs.source_reference: Safran / GE Aerospace Engine Technical Briefings / Aviation Week MRO Watch

stories.headline: easyJet Shareholders Approve £5.7 Billion Apollo Takeover
stories.lead: easyJet shareholders have voted to approve a £5.7 billion takeover offer by US private equity firm Apollo. The transaction received overwhelming support during Wednesday's shareholder meeting.
detailed_analysis: A total of 97.07% of votes cast at Wednesday's shareholder meeting backed the acquisition of the Luton-based carrier.
The approved deal values easyJet at £5.7 billion under the acquisition terms with Apollo.
The shareholder vote marks a key step in moving the airline under private equity ownership.
stories.strategic_impact: Ownership of the airline shifts to private equity, likely influencing future capital structure and strategic positioning.

market_exposure.details: Shareholders approved the £5.7 billion takeover proposal with 97.07% of votes cast.

stories.article_body: Alaska Airlines adds four new cities to its Seattle network, plus a new seasonal nonstop route to Guadalajara, Mexico
detailed_analysis: Alaska Airlines is expanding its Seattle hub with 4 new domestic routes launching in June 2027 to Charlotte, Des Moines, Jacksonville, and Norfolk.

stories.headline: Virgin Australia Selects Delta TechOps for Fleetwide 737 Component Support
stories.lead: Virgin Australia has awarded Delta TechOps a five-year fleetwide component support contract for its Boeing 737 aircraft. The partnership expands an existing maintenance relationship across more than 100 narrowbody jets.
stories.source_description: Virgin Australia has selected Delta TechOps to provide fleetwide component support for its more than 100 Boeing 737NG and 737 MAX aircraft, expanding a on an existing maintenance relationship and further growing TechOps’ presence in the Asia-Pacific region. The five-year agreement covers airframe components along with engine components for both the CFM56-7B and CFM LEAP-1B engines. Delta TechOps teams will perform the work primarily in Atlanta and Minneapolis with logistics support from Virgin Australia in Singapore, Brisbane, Melbourne and Sydney. TechOps previously supported the airline's CFM56-7B engines and completed component repairs across its fleet “Virgin Australia’s 737s are central to its operation, and we appreciate the confidence placed in Delta TechOps to support this fleet. As an airline operator ourselves, we understand what aircraft availability means to a schedule and to the customers who depend on it. Delta TechOps also continues to broaden its support of airline customers across the Pacific, including providing maintenance for Korean Air’s CFM LEAP-1B engines, the same engine family that powers Virgin Australia’s Boeing 737 MAX aircraft. Backed by the experience of maintaining one of the world's largest airline fleets, TechOps supports more than 150 customers across six continents. As North America's largest MRO provider, TechOps services more than 100,000 aircraft components annually through 25 in-house component shops and remains the only provider in the Americas certified to support the CFM LEAP, Pratt & Whitney GTF and Rolls-Royce Trent engine families.

stories.headline: Emirates Wins Gold at 2026 Global Performance Marketing Awards
stories.lead: Emirates was awarded Gold in the inaugural Best Travel, Leisure & Experience Campaign category at the 2026 Global Performance Marketing Awards for transforming its Asia Pacific affiliate marketing programme.
stories.source_description: Inaugural winner in the Best Travel, Leisure & Experience Campaign award category Recognised for the transformation of its Asia Pacific affiliate programme Performance marketing is a fundamental customer growth driver for Emirates Dubai, UAE, 12 November 2026: Emirates has won Gold in the inaugural Best Travel, Leisure & Experience Campaign category at the 2026 Global Performance Marketing Awards. Emirates was recognised as the first-ever winner of the Best Travel, Leisure & Experience Campaign award for its work to transform its affiliate marketing programme in Asia Pacific (APAC) - one of the world’s most competitive travel markets where online travel agencies, airlines and travel agents all compete for the same affiliate partners. The airline rebuilt its affiliate marketing programme by shifting from broad publisher volumes to a refined partner base that works harder without sacrificing efficiency, strengthening direct relationships, and focusing on investments that delivered the greatest impact, along with expanding into new affiliate partner categories. As a result, the airline’s revenue growth from performance marketing in APAC rose 31% in a single year. At Emirates, performance marketing operates as a strategic engine for customer growth, not only as a marketing channel. An internal team of specialists combine channel expertise with advanced analytics, attribution, customer insights and rich first-party data, and keep a consistent focus on driving incremental revenue, customer quality and lifetime value. Boutros Boutros, Executive Vice President, Corporate Communications, Marketing & Brand for Emirates Group, said : “We’re proud to be recognised at the Global Performance Marketing Awards. This accolade underscores the team’s commitment to deliver real value for our customers and for the business. Performance marketing is a fundamental commercial growth driver for Emirates, and the team’s rigorous, data-led approach combined with smart automation, delivers substantial value back to the business. Their success is driven by clear strategy, well-defined objectives and disciplined execution, and we’ve improved both the quality of our bookings and revenue outcomes in APAC. It’s a win-win, and congratulations to all the teams involved.” Emirates’ performance marketing at a glance A core team in Dubai covers affiliate marketing, paid search and metasearch, supported by over 60 digital marketing colleagues and hundreds of partners globally. Together, these three channels delivers more than a third of new customers acquired through emirates.com. The team manages strategy and execution for more than 5,000 always-on campaigns worldwide across search engines, flight search websites and affiliate marketing partners. Big data from partners powers this always-on engine and guides strategic investment decisions supporting more than 4,000 routes in 80 markets. High levels of automation and strict processes allow the team to operate at this scale while keeping decisions consistent, with dedicated specialists across each discipline ensuring best-in-class execution and governance. Exclusive partnerships enable Emirates to bring industry-first and industry-leading advertising solutions to market. About the awards The Global Performance Marketing Awards recognise work that drives measurable growth across performance and partnership marketing, and represent the collaborative efforts of brands, agencies, publishers and technology platforms. Entries are scored independently by multiple senior judges from brands, agencies and publishers across the industry, assessing each entry on strategic clarity, quality of execution, partnership collaboration and measurable commercial impact. This latest win follows Emirates’ shortlisting at the Global Search Awards for Best Use of Search (Travel/Leisure).

stories.headline: Delta Marks Veterans Day Highlighting Military Veteran Workforce
stories.lead: Delta Air Lines recognized its veteran workforce during its 15th annual Veterans Day celebration held at its Technical Operations Center.
stories.source_description: This Veterans Day, Delta is celebrating the more than 11,000 veterans across our workforce whose service strengthens our people, culture and operation every day. Veterans comprise ~11 percent of Delta’s workforce, bringing valuable experience and perspectives across the enterprise. Honoring the sacrifices of Delta people Last week, Delta’s 15th annual Veterans Day celebration brought employees, families and friends together at Delta’s Technical Operations Center to honor the service, sacrifice and enduring contributions of teammates and community members who have served our country. The two-day event featured military aircraft displays, a 200-foot military memorabilia wall and opportunities to reflect on the generations of service members whose leadership shaped Delta today. "Standing alongside fellow Delta veterans, military families and distinguished guests at this year's Veterans Day celebration was a powerful reminder of the dedication and sacrifice represented across our workforce," said Chief Operating Officer Dan Janki. "The leadership, resilience and commitment our veterans bring to Delta help us serve our customers and support one another every day. We are proud to honor their service and grateful for the lasting impact they have on our company." Distinguished guests included U.S. Secretary of Veterans Affairs Doug Collins; Medal of Honor recipient Terry Richardson, a veteran of the Vietnam and Iraq wars; 11 Desert Storm veterans; three World War II veterans; and Delta senior leaders — Chief Operating Officer Dan Janki, Senior Vice President of TechOps David Thompson and Senior Vice President of Flight Operations Ryan Gumm. Sylvester Johnson, AMT - TechOps Years with Delta: 29 years Military Branch: U.S. Army Background: Inspired by a childhood trip to an air show, Sylvester joined the U.S. Army in 1989, serving as an aircraft electrician and door gunner during deployments to Desert Storm, northern Iraq and Somalia. Throughout both his military and Delta careers, teamwork has been a constant. "In both the military and at Delta, people come from different backgrounds and experiences, but everyone is working toward one common goal." Sean Coppinger, AMT - TechOps Years with Delta: 29 years Military Branch: U.S. Army Background: Before joining Delta nearly 29 years ago, he served as a U.S. Army Black Hawk helicopter crew chief and door gunner, stationed in Germany during the fall of the Berlin Wall and later deploying during Operations Desert Shield and Desert Storm. During the Gulf War, Sean supported senior military leadership, giving him a unique perspective on one of the most significant military operations of his generation. Today, Sean sees many of those same principles at work in TechOps, particularly in Cabin Maintenance. "The military is all about teamwork. Everyone has a role, and success depends on people working together toward the same goal." Continue the celebrations of our bravest this week Join Delta as we continue honoring the service, sacrifice and stories of our nation's veterans at a special day of remembrance. Where: Delta Flight Museum When: Friday, Nov. 13 What: Historic WWII DC-3 Experience | 9 a.m. – 1 p.m. Special Film Screening: “Why We Dream” | 1 p.m. Honor a Veteran : Throughout the day, guests are invited to write a note honoring a veteran in their life — whether a family member, friend or someone whose service they wish to recognize. How to attend: Delta employees and retirees (plus three guests) always receive complimentary admission to the Museum. Friends, family and the public are invited to join by purchasing tickets on the museum website or in person. More details: Delta Flight Museum: Honoring Veterans Supporting veterans beyond Veterans Day Veterans Day is one celebration of recognition, but Delta's commitment to veterans extends year-round through programs, partnerships and resources designed to help service members, veterans and military families succeed. Last week, Delta was ranked No. 2 on Forbes list of America’s Best Employers For Veterans 2026 . Delta's belief is that supporting veterans means more than hiring talented people. Veterans bring valuable and specialized experiences and skills to the workforce, and Delta is committed to ensuring those strengths are recognized, understood and positioned for success in a corporate environment. Through targeted development opportunities and support, Delta is helping veterans thrive in their next mission. Creating pathways to opportunity through partnerships including Military MOJO, Service Academy Career Conference, Value of a Veteran, MBA Veterans Network, FourBlock and the Army PaYS Program. Investing in career growth through coaching, mentorship and development opportunities that help veterans navigate the transition from military service to corporate careers. Delta's Military Skills Translator tool helps veteran job seekers understand how their military skills, experience and training translate to roles at Delta. Building community and connection through the Veterans Business Resource Group, which supports veterans, active service members and military allies through networking, volunteering and professional development. Supporting military families and communities through longstanding partnerships with organizations including Fisher House Foundation, Folds of Honor, Luke's Wings, USO, Armed Forces Service Centers in DTW, MIA and MSP, Camp Southern Ground, Best Defense Foundation, The Medal of Honor Foundation, The Warrior Alliance, and Marine Toys for Tots Foundation. ICYMI by Forbes: When It Comes To Elevating Veteran Values, Delta Air Lines Soars Preserving the legacy of service Delta is also committed to ensuring the stories and sacrifices of veterans continue to inspire future generations. Our employees have helped shine a light on the heroes behind those stories, creating meaningful connections between generations and reinforcing the enduring impact of service. Honoring veterans 2026 Commemorative Air Force Moonlight Swing Gala: Delta served as title sponsor recognizing Normandy Legacy Flight veterans and Veterans Business Resource Group (BRG) caregivers. New England Honor Flight: We team up with the Honor Flight New England to recognize veterans through a special trip to Washington, D.C., and visits to the memorials dedicated to their service and sacrifice. Several Veteran BRG members served as guardians, supporting veterans throughout the journey. Normandy Legacy Flight: We work with the Best Defense Foundation and Michelin North America, Inc., to bring World War II veterans back to Normandy, France and pay tribute to the anniversary of the D-Day landings, honoring these legendary heroes and preserving their stories for generations to come. Delta, Best Defense Foundation return to Normandy for fifth year as America celebrates its 250th Delta proudly continues its Normandy Legacy Flight, a program that brings World War II veterans and students back to Normandy, France, on June 3 to commemorate the 82nd anniversary of D-Day. stories.headline: Emirates Skywards Launches 'Miles More Rewarding' Global Campaign

A morning coffee for mum, a shopping spree for the kids, a football match for dad, or a family holiday everyone can look forward to. Whatever their interests, Emirates Skywards has a way to make it more rewarding. With more than 40 million members worldwide, Emirates Skywards offers an extensive ecosystem of travel and lifestyle rewards. But there's much more to the programme than earning Miles on flights. From gym sessions and online shopping to hotel stays and exclusive entertainment, members can discover rewarding opportunities in places they might least expect. Tips & tricks for the whole family For the everyday hacker: Rack up Miles automatically on everyday activities A morning coffee could be the start of the next holiday. From coffee runs and groceries to dining, services, shopping and wellness, the Skywards Everyday app lets members earn Miles at more than 500 participating brands across the UAE, such as noon Food, Costa Coffee, CÉ LA VI, Laundry Heap and many more. Simply save up to five payment cards and collect Miles automatically on purchases - turning daily spending into Miles. Shopping spree at Dubai Mall comes with a bonus. Earn Skywards Miles while shopping, dining or unwinding at over 1,300 outlets in Dubai Mall . Simply download the Dubai Mall app, link an Emirates Skywards account and scan receipts for purchases over AED 100. Shop online and watch the Miles multiply. Earn and spend Miles with thousands of brands across the US, UK, UAE, India and Australia on Skywardsmilesmall.com, from Amazon UAE, Apple UK, Nike and more. Simply log in with an Emirates Skywards account before shopping. Credit cards that accelerate rewards. Emirates Skywards co-branded credit cards offer opportunities to earn Miles on everyday spending and maximise earning when paying for Emirates and flydubai flights plus extras. Members can also double their Miles when spending with any Skywards partner or triple their Miles with Skywards Everyday partners at Dubai Mall . Select cards also offer tier status, putting members on the fast track to elite benefits from day one. For the experience lover: Spend and Earn Miles on memorable moments Miles could get members closer to the action. Spend the Skywards Miles on concerts, comedy shows and sporting events and more, via Skywards Exclusives . Starting from just 5,000 Miles, get access to live shows at Coca-Cola Arena and popular events like the Australian Open, Wimbledon, European football matches, or NBA Basketball games in the US. Some of the most exclusive Skywards redemptions aren’t even flights - they are money-can’t-buy experiences that Emirates can provide, including a behind the scenes tour of the Dilmah Tea Planation in Sri Lanka and a trip to the Champagne region of France with Moët Hennessy . A staycation could be just a few Miles away. Skywards Miles can be earned on a stay or turned into complimentary or discounted stays when booking with hotel partners such as Emirates Skywards Hotels , Marriott Bonvoy , IHG Hotels & Resorts , and many more. Make the next holiday twice as rewarding. Earn twice on flights and stays. With the Emirates Skywards- Marriott Bonvoy partnership, eligible members can earn both Skywards Miles and Marriott Bonvoy points on Emirates flights and stays at hotels participating in the Marriott Bonvoy programme. Skywards Miles can also be converted to Marriott Bonvoy points and vice versa - handy if someone is short of one or the other for a big redemption, or the holiday of their dreams. Love is in the Miles. Spoil a loved one by gifting Skywards Miles for family and friends, and let them treat themselves to a Classic Reward flight or upgrade on their next trip. The price of 1,000 Skywards Miles is USD 30 or transfer from an existing balance - the extra gained through everyday Miles earnings. For the travel enthusiast: Make every journey count Not enough Miles for a ticket? No problem. With Cash + Miles , members can instantly reduce the amount of cash needed to pay for a ticket by combining Skywards Miles with cash towards Emirates and flydubai flights. That cabin upgrade might be closer than you think. Members can redeem Miles towards Emirates flight upgrades, subject to availability – it’s always good to ask at the airport check-in desk. These opportunities can pop up unexpectedly right up until departure or even onboard. Travel beyond Emirates and flydubai. Every Emirates Skywards member earns Skywards Miles on airline partner flights across 1,400 flight destinations! Fly with Emirates, flydubai , Aegean Airlines, Air Canada, Air Mauritius, Azul, Bangkok Airways, Condor, Copa Airlines, Garuda Indonesia, GOL, Japan Airlines, Jetstar, Korean Air, Malaysia Airlines, Olympic Air, Qantas, South African Airways, TAP Air Portugal and United Airlines, to start earning. Unlock Airport Lounge experiences, regardless of Cabin Class. Skywards Gold and Platinum members get complimentary access to Emirates’ world-class Business Class and First Class lounges in Dubai to enjoy unlimited gourmet cuisine, Champagne bars, spa treatments and private sleeping pods - even if they’re flying in Economy Class. For the family planner: More rewarding together Little travellers can start earning too. Skywards Skysurfers loyalty programme even lets younger members earn Miles in their own account, and best of all, the Miles don’t expire until they reach age 21. Make the family holiday a team effort. From flights and upgrades to shared experiences, members can use pooled Miles towards rewards, helping bring their next adventure closer. The Birthday Surprise. Birthdays deserve a little extra celebration! Active Emirates Skywards members can enjoy a special offer during their birthday month, with exciting rewards throughout the year. From bonus Miles on flights and extra Miles when shopping through Skywards Miles Mall, to exclusive offers from Skywards Exclusives and the Emirates Official Store, there’s always something to make their special day even more rewarding. More ways to multiply rewards . Members can double, triple, or quadruple the Miles they have recently earned on flights and with participating partners . Multiply by paying only USD 20 for every 1,000 Miles; members can Multiply up to 50,000 Miles every year. As Emirates Skywards continues to evolve, members can look forward to enhancements designed to deliver greater flexibility, choice, recognition and rewarding opportunities, including further developments to the family experience. Discover what makes Skywards more rewarding at skywards.com .
